sources.title: Classificazione internazionale dei reati
limitations: This source materialises the ICCS hierarchy and labels, not Italian legal offence mappings.
Source drift is guarded by content hashes, expected roots and minimum node-count checks.

sources.title: Classificazione sintetica dei reati
limitations: This is a national statistical hierarchy, not the legal offence catalogue.
Parent relationships and validity labels are preserved exactly as exposed by Istat.

sources.title: Classificazione analitica dei reati
limitations: The rendered table does not expose an ID PADRE field; LTCEDS therefore does not infer a hierarchy from code prefixes.
This classification remains a separate namespace from ICCS and the legal offence catalogue.

sources.title: Gruppi di reato
limitations: Groups are cross-cutting attributes and are not treated as an exclusive offence hierarchy.
An offence may belong to multiple groups; catalogue-to-group membership remains part of the official navigator/correspondence surface and is not inferred here.

sources.title: Catalogo dei reati
limitations: Istat currently declares the catalogue updated to legislation of interest through December 2024; this is coverage metadata, not the page publication date.
The public page is an interactive search surface; no stable machine endpoint has yet been committed to LTCEDS.
Istat itself notes that editorial normative collections may contain errors, inaccuracies or omissions.

sources.title: Navigatore delle classificazioni dei reati
sources.attribution: Istat — Navigatore delle classificazioni dei reati
limitations: Istat documents bidirectional catalogue/classification navigation and non-trivial 1:N, N:1 and exceptional cardinalities.
LTCEDS must not reconstruct correspondence from label, article or code similarity while the official correspondence surface is not yet materialised.

sources.provider: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
sources.title: International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes (ICCS): Implementation Manual
limitations: The manual is referenced for implementation guidance; this inventory does not assert a reuse licence for reproducing its text.
The Istat hierarchy snapshots remain separate sourced artefacts.
